title: Encrypted Messaging Risk Calculator - Assess Your Privacy Score
metaDescription: Calculate your encrypted messaging privacy risk. Assess Signal, WhatsApp, Telegram security and get personalized recommendations for safer communications.
description: Evaluate your encrypted messaging security with our comprehensive risk assessment tool. Input your messaging habits and app usage to receive a personalized privacy score and actionable recommendations for protecting your communications.

inputs.label: Primary messaging app you use
inputs.helpText: The messaging app you use most frequently for personal communications

inputs.label: Frequency of sensitive conversations
inputs.helpText: How often you discuss private, personal, or confidential matters

inputs.label: Cloud backup enabled for messages
inputs.helpText: Whether your messages are backed up to iCloud, Google Drive, etc.

inputs.label: Message history retention
inputs.helpText: How long you keep message history before deleting

inputs.label: Device access by others
inputs.helpText: How often others have access to your messaging device

inputs.label: App-specific screen lock
inputs.helpText: Whether you use additional PIN/biometric lock for your messaging app

inputs.label: Read receipts enabled
inputs.helpText: Whether read receipts are turned on in your messaging apps

inputs.label: Number of group chats you're in
inputs.helpText: Total number of group conversations across all messaging apps

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your overall encrypted messaging privacy risk (0-100, lower is better)

outputFields.label: Security Grade
outputFields.description: Letter grade assessment of your messaging security practices

outputFields.label: Primary Recommendation
outputFields.description: Most important action to improve your messaging privacy

formula: const appRisk = { signal: 5, whatsapp: 15, telegram: 25, imessage: 20, messenger: 40, sms: 50, other: 30 }; const sensitivityRisk = { never: 0, rarely: 5, sometimes: 15, often: 25, daily: 35 }; const backupRisk = { no: 0, yes: 20, unsure: 10 }; const retentionRisk = { '1day': 0, '1week': 2, '1month': 5, '1year': 10, forever: 15 }; const sharingRisk = { never: 0, rarely: 5, sometimes: 15, often: 25 }; let risk = appRisk[primaryApp] + sensitivityRisk[sensitiveMessages] + backupRisk[cloudBackup] + retentionRisk[messageRetention] + sharingRisk[deviceSharing]; risk += screenLock ? -5 : 10; risk += readReceipts ? 5 : 0; risk += Math.min(groupChats * 0.5, 15); const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, risk)); const securityGrade = riskScore <= 20 ? 'A' : riskScore <= 35 ? 'B' : riskScore <= 50 ? 'C' : riskScore <= 70 ? 'D' : 'F'; let recommendation = 'Enable disappearing messages'; if (primaryApp === 'sms' || primaryApp === 'messenger') recommendation = 'Switch to Signal or WhatsApp'; else if (cloudBackup === 'yes') recommendation = 'Disable cloud backup for messages'; else if (!screenLock) recommendation = 'Enable app-specific screen lock'; return { riskScore, securityGrade, recommendation };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your encrypted messaging privacy based on app security features, usage patterns, device security, and data retention practices. Risk factors are weighted by their impact on potential privacy exposure.
tips: Use Signal for the highest security - it has the strongest encryption and privacy features
Disable cloud backups for messaging apps as they often store messages unencrypted
Enable disappearing messages for sensitive conversations
Use app-specific locks for additional security if others access your device
Regularly review and leave unnecessary group chats to limit exposure
Turn off read receipts to maintain privacy about when you read messages
Browse privately with Incognito Browser when researching sensitive topics you might discuss
Verify security numbers in Signal and WhatsApp for important contacts

interpretation.label: Excellent Security

interpretation.label: High Risk

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Your current messaging setup provides minimal privacy protection. Immediate changes recommended.
